case.title: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
case.briefing: The new PX pump series needs shaft SH-220 (1.4021). Two suppliers quote: a German job shop and a Polish machining company. Lead time must not exceed 42 days; the line needs parts within 35 days, every day later costs EUR 150. Machined shafts are a leverage category: several capable suppliers, the goal is the lowest total cost. Award one.

sup:DEMO-J1.subject: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
sup:DEMO-J1.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We can offer you a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.

As a small shop, we like to keep things practical and clear for our customers. Everything is set up on our end to run your parts efficiently, and we look forward to working together on this order.

Let us know if this works for you so we can get started.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for your clear and practical offer for the SH-220 shaft. We appreciate how quickly you set things up, and we would be glad to work with your shop.

To be transparent, we have a competing offer on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 16.00 for this part (offer:DEMO-C1-0).

To give you a fair chance at the award, we have prepared three options:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 15.13; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 14.69; payment 45 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.03; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

Option C keeps your usual payment term unchanged. If one of these works for you, we can move ahead quickly.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Kaczmarek,

Thank you for your prompt and friendly offer for the SH-220 stainless pump shaft. We appreciate your interest in working with us and share the goal of a reliable long-term partnership.

We have reviewed your proposal carefully. To make an award possible, we would need terms closer to the following. Each option includes delivery to our site, and you can choose the balance of price and payment term that suits you best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.15; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 13.74; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 14.10; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days; Incoterm DAP.

We would be glad to receive your confirmation of the option that works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We can include DAP delivery and drop our price to EUR 15.70, which beats your other offer. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €15.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days, delivery DAP. As a small shop we need to keep cash flowing, so we have to stick to the 30 days payment from Option C. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price.

Gruß
Claudia Aigner
Owner, Demo Drehteile GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Drehteile GmbH: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear Ms Aigner,

Thank you for checking the competing quote so carefully and for improving your offer, including DAP delivery. We appreciate it.

We understand that steady cash flow matters to a small shop. With that in mind, we have updated our options. Option C keeps the payment term you asked to retain. Option A offers even faster payment if that suits you better.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 14.76; payment 14 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 15.20; payment 60 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 15.10; payment 30 days net; lead time 28 days; Incoterm DAP.

As you are clarifying internally, we hope these options make the discussion simple. We look forward to your reply and to starting work together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.: New stainless pump shaft SH-220: award one of two suppliers
message.body:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We are pleased to accommodate your request for DAP delivery and a 35-day lead time to support your operational requirements.

Please note that shifting from EXW to DAP and expediting the production schedule incurs substantial logistics and manufacturing costs, resulting in a unit price of €16.70. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. We have maintained the 45-day payment term to ensure a balanced agreement and demonstrate our commitment to this partnership.

Under this updated Angebot, we provide a price of €16.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, and delivery DAP. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
